name: ChairHandler
description: ChairHandler is an actor, roleplayer, DJ, and Twitch streamer who joined [VRChat](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/VRChat) in mid-2020 after being invited by a friend to visit [Roflgator](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Roflgator)'s bar community. He became a regular of the [Gator RP Group](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Gator_RP_Group) and [The Bike Lobby](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/The_Bike_Lobby), later commissioning and hosting the launch of a custom hangout world. Outside VRChat he is also known for GTA V roleplay on the NoPixel server, performing as a parody character inspired by The Walking Dead.
